headline: Factory Construction Trend Lowest Since 2021, Revealed in Government Survey Report
summary: A government survey report shows the trend of new factory construction in India has declined since 2021 and has reached its lowest level in that period.
why: Factory construction is a leading indicator of manufacturing capacity and industrial investment, which feed into economic growth and corporate capital spending.
